text:
Alex: Heads up — staging-west2 is seeing a sudden backlog in the prom remotes (remote_write) and a bunch of timeouts. P95 latency to our ingest endpoint jumped and the queue is stacking. :fire_engine:
Sam: Seeing the same, grafana shows a spike in 'prometheus_remote_write_queue_length' and 'http_request_errors' for the gpu-exporter targets.
Mira: Any recent relabel or scrape config changes pushed to staging?
Alex: Not from me. I did notice a giant jump in cardinality coming from node_exporter/gpu_exporter: extra device labels per-GPU and per-process tags. Example lines in logs: 
```
POST /api/v1/write 504 upstream timeout (payload 8.3MB, chunks 2)
series=412394 -> 1.2M series/snapshot
```
Chris: That payload size seems high. Could be MTU fragmentation + retries making requests slow. We had a kube-proxy update in that region yesterday.
Sam: ops-bot fired alerts at 1968001200 for remote_write_queue_length > 4000, I muted notifications but the backend still throttled.
ops-bot: Alert: remote_write_queue_length (staging-west2) = 4789 triggered by prom-remote-writer-01.
ingest-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0412 - staging prom backpressure. Assigned: Mira.
Mira: Quick mitigation steps I can take now: 1) add immediate relabel to drop high-cardinality gpu_perf_* metrics 2) reduce scrape_interval for gpu targets from 15s->60s 3) split gpu exporters to a separate remote_write shard. Thoughts?
Alex: Do 1 + 2 ASAP. 3 needs infra work. Also can we lower 'max_request_body_size' on the sender so it chunks earlier?
Sam: Relabel snippet that helped before: 
```
- job_name: 'gpu-exporter'
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ['__name__']
    regex: 'gpu_perf_.*'
    action: drop
  - source_labels: ['device']
    regex: '.*-fan-.*'
    action: labeldrop
```
Mira: Pushed temporary relabel patch to staging prom via quick rollback pipeline. Reducing scrape interval now.
Chris: I still want us to validate MTU/path-MTU. I'll run mtr and tcpdump on the node with high retransmits. Could be kube-proxy conntrack/encap causing fragmentation.
Sam: Can we also add an alert rule tweak: raise alert threshold for queue_length by 20% while we mitigate to reduce noise?
Alex: Yes, bump thresholds in staging only, add runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prom-remote-backpressure
Mira: After the change queue length dropped to ~600 and errors reduced. Leaving an action item: implement per-cluster remote_write sharding + long-term relabeling and add e2e test for payload fragmentation.
Chris: Filed infra ticket INF-5822 to revert kube-proxy change if MTU checks fail.
Alex: Great. Closing incident once 24h stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
